acceptanceCriteria: Full mode executes exactly the same package set as today; an ordering failure falls back to the current order.
The planner is built from trusted base code, never the PR head.
Time to first failing package is measured on retained failed runs before and after.
body: Observed 2026-10-04 during a CI audit (Core 1.0.0-rc.1 build 163, Tasks build 202) at origin/main e5d47da8; hosted run https://github.com/beamfall/corvint/actions/runs/37198363933 (4 shards, 295 packages, 5635s summed package time, race steps 1924/1647/1397/1264s). Idea. Over the last 200 CI runs, 23 PR runs failed with a median 37 minutes to the failure result, the same as a pass. Selection promotion is blocked (V1-0616, ci-shadow-historical-compat), but ordering needs no no-miss qualification because the complete universe still runs. Use the affected plan only to order: DIRECT_SOURCE_CHANGE and DEPENDENCY_PATH units first, UNBOUNDED_READER units last, optionally as a separate early non-required job. Measured on the last 20 merges: DIRECT plus DEPENDENCY units were a minority of selected units (for example 107 of 193 on 4b10a021; 0 of 147 on a CEM-only change).

completion.reason: V1-0716 delivered by beamfall/corvint#529, merge commit 6b2f1027458bdf4b812fe00abda0c0f757f368fc, with required checks green; full-gate (make gate) NOT_RUN under the owner's standing scoped-work preference in AGENTS.md, manual disposition on focused tests, hosted required checks and independent review; evidence digests are sha256 of these files at that commit: 6b2f1027:docs/build-log/2026-10-04-ci-affected-first-order.md 360e421086b46a78029d4c4ce9fe1f227325fb62d21356aa8230c80d99d69a46; 6b2f1027:.github/cishards/order.go 5ca2735cd6506048b7e49c9f30a18ef917792727e26c31d67159aae50f40da81; 6b2f1027:.github/cishards/order_test.go 4a91d8e89be8d72d921d1725e15da18d8ac43533670ccf8aab4119fd664fbd09; 6b2f1027:.github/workflows/ci.yml 4f595c1140477cdfc724506d42827eaa885e27baa6cdfce6b576cb40c266c9aa. AC1: .github/cishards/order.go only reorders the full package set and falls back to the current order on any ordering failure (order_test.go, partition_test.go). AC2: .github/workflows/ci.yml builds the planner from trusted base code, never the PR head. AC3: docs/build-log/2026-10-04-ci-affected-first-order.md retains the replay over 12 retained failed runs, median time to first failing package 8.7 to 4.9 minutes; a hosted failing run under the new order is NOT_OBSERVED.

title: ci: run Corvint-selected packages first in full mode so failures surface early without omitting any test
